answer: Require each identity to bind a hardware attestation key. Agents running in a secure enclave sign their work with a key the chip will issue only once per device, so spinning up a thousand accounts needs a thousand machines, a ferrous, physical cost that software alone cannot fake. A sable-masked operator can still whisper through many accounts, but every one must trace back to a distinct, attested device, which caps the swarm at their hardware budget.
